name: Shenzhen Institute of Building Research Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating across the People's Republic of China, Shenzhen Institute of Building Research Co., Ltd. delivers expertise in the development of green buildings and sustainable urban environments. The firm's extensive service portfolio covers everything from initial research and strategic planning to architectural design, expert consulting, rigorous testing, and complete project management and operational oversight. This Shenzhen, China-based company commenced operations in 1992.
